# FlareCaptionButton

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareCaptionButton`

A title-bar caption control: one native button carrying the host's glyph, accessible label and command. The component owns the measured title-bar box and every visual state through the public --flare-caption-* tokens; it adds no product text, icon or command of its own. Mousedown propagation is always stopped, so pressing a caption never starts a title-bar drag, and OnMouseDown lets the host observe the press when it needs to.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible label forwarded as aria-label. Strongly recommended: the control is icon-only and the library supplies no product text. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Custom glyph content, used in place of Icon. The host owns its size and paint when it supplies this. |
| `Disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Disables the control. The disabled state still reserves the measured title-bar box but draws no hover or pressed surface. |
| `Icon` | `FlareIcon?` | `` | Parameter |  | The glyph rendered inside the control - any provider (FlareSvgIcon or an add-on pack type). It is drawn at the theme's caption glyph size unless the descriptor states its own size. Ignored when ChildContent is supplied. |
| `Kind` | `CaptionButtonKind` | `CaptionButtonKind.Minimize` | Parameter |  | Which window command the control represents. The kind marks the control for tests and styling and gives the close control its danger paint; it does not decide the glyph, label or command. Defaults to Minimize, the harmless choice when a host omits it. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback invoked when the control is clicked. The host runs its window command here. |
| `OnMouseDown` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback invoked when the control receives a mousedown, after propagation has been stopped. Use it when the host needs to observe the press; the stop itself is always applied, so a title-bar drag never starts from a caption control. |
| `Tooltip` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Hint shown on hover (native title), normally the same words as the accessible label. For a styled bubble, wrap the control in a FlareTooltip instead. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
